_huong_dan: Dan phan 'rules' ben duoi vao Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules > Publish.
Bo rules nay lam:
1. crmData (kho GOC): chi UID cu 7ePgCPmzxHdEAEazHo9IkyKf2rw2 moi doc/ghi.
Day la du lieu dang chay cua tai khoan cu, KHONG bi tai khoan khac dung toi.
MCP server cung dung dung nhanh nay.
2. crmData_users/<uid>: MOI tai khoan chu co mot kho RIENG o day, va chi
dung chinh chu moi doc/ghi duoc kho cua minh. Tai khoan moi
HGpKBnj7qiUvKTG8HvcI72Se4Qr2 dung crmData_users/HGpKBnj7qiUvKTG8HvcI72Se4Qr2,
tach biet hoan toan voi du lieu cu.
3. Ghi nhat ky dang nhap vao authLog: BAT KY tai khoan nao dang nhap qua app
deu bi ghi lai (de bat duoc ke la), nhung CHI tai khoan cu moi doc duoc.
Nhat ky khong the sua hay xoa boi nguoi khac - chi tao moi.
MCP server khong bi anh huong: no dung service account, quyen admin, bo qua rules.
NHO LAM THEM: Console > Authentication > Settings > User actions >
TAT 'Enable create (sign-up)'. Neu khong, nguoi la van tu tao tai khoan duoc
(ho khong doc duoc du lieu, nhung chan ngay tu dau van hon).
Ghi chu ky thuat:
- crmData va crmData_users/<uid> dung chung mot bo .validate cho leads/planRevenue/planLeads.
- appConfig: chua khoa ket noi MCP do app tu sinh, chi tai khoan cu doc/ghi duoc.
- appConfig_users/<uid> va shareLog_users/<uid>: cau hinh share + khoa MCP + nhat ky rieng cua tung tai khoan moi; chi chinh chu doc/ghi (nhat ky chi doc, backend admin ghi).
- authLog: ai dang nhap cung ghi duoc mot dong moi, nhung khong ai sua/xoa duoc dong da co, va chi tai khoan cu doc duoc.
LUU Y: Firebase Console KHONG chap nhan khoa _huong_dan (bao loi 'Expected rules property').
De dan vao Console, dung file 'firebase-rules-deploy.json' (chi co khoi rules). File nay
chi de doc/ghi chu, giu trong repo.
- zalo / zalo_users: du lieu extension Zalo (hoi thoai da gan lead). Chu cu dung 'zalo', tai khoan khac dung 'zalo_users/<uid>'.
